note.appPassword: {p} needs an app-specific password (made in your account settings on the web) — your normal password is refused.

set.title: Settings
set.imagesHint: Blocked pictures can't tell senders that you read their mail.
set.autoHide: Hide menu and status bar automatically
set.accountsHint: Passwords are kept in the system's keychain, never in a file.
keys.hint: Click a shortcut and press the new keys. Backspace removes it, Esc cancels.
keys.needMod: Please with Ctrl or Alt (or a function key).
keys.taken: {k} belonged to „{a}“ — that one has no shortcut now.
keys.fixed: {k} belongs to „{a}“ and can't be changed.
about.p1: Mail Studio reads and writes e-mail for all your accounts (IMAP and SMTP): iCloud, Gmail, GMX, WEB.DE, Proton Mail through the Bridge and any other provider.
about.p2: Passwords stay in the system's keychain. Messages you read are kept on this computer, so they open without a connection.
about.p3: Part of the Studio family. Pictures from the internet are blocked until you allow them; scripts in e-mails never run.
